title: GeoGPT: AI-driven Marine Ecosystem Monitoring and Protection
summary: GeoGPT reports marine-image recognition in 40 milliseconds versus 40 seconds manually, alongside species-classification and exploration tools.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Zhejiang Lab describes a research and product platform for geoscience analysis. It reports 81.3% deep-sea species identification accuracy and a reduction from 40 seconds to 40 milliseconds per image. The intended applications include marine monitoring and less disruptive exploration. Avoided ecosystem losses remain unestablished.
purpose: Accelerate geoscience information processing and support marine decisions.

ratings.reason: Image processing reportedly takes 40 milliseconds, compared with 40 seconds manually. Ecological outcomes remain unestablished.
Reduced mining damage and avoided algal disasters are intended rather than observed outcomes.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.
